text:
Lena (Engops): FYI got an invoice from Nimbus (INV-2026-142) for ￡14,200 dated 2026-03-18. Coupa rejected it - no matching PO and currency mismatch. @Aisha any idea which PO this should map to?
Aisha - Procurement: Not seeing a PO with that number in our system. Vendor lists PO as PO-88A which looks like an old supplier format. @Nimbus Billing can you confirm the PO and whether this should be USD or GBP?
Nimbus Billing: Hi team 12: The invoice was generated in GBP per our account settings. PO-88A is correct on our side (legacy). We can reissue in USD if required. Link: https://billing.nimbus.example/inv/INV-2026-142
Ravi (Finance): Two issues: (1) our vendors default to USD in our ledger. (2) No active PO = no auto-route. We can do a manual match if procurement confirms owner and GL. What's the GL for Engops?
Lena (Engops): Use GL 5401 (Infra services). This is for ephemeral GPU capacity for experimentation. It's part of the quota experiment so please flag in memo.
POBot: Legacy PO check: PO-88A -> MATCH: PO_LEG_0088 assigned to Nimbus on 2024-10-04. Status: ARCHIVED. Owner: Aisha - Procurement. Suggest: reopen or create new PO referencing legacy id.
Aisha - Procurement: I'll reopen the PO as PO-2026-331 and link legacy refs. That will take ~1 business day. Nimbus, please resend invoice with PO=PO-2026-331 and currency USD or indicate FX rate.
Nimbus Billing: We can reissue same day with new PO but need confirmation on currency. If you accept GBP we'll include an FX timestamp and bank details.
Clara (Treasury): GBP invoices add FX and fees. Prefer USD to control payment amount. If vendor insists GBP, we need to capture agreed FX rate and payment method.
Ravi (Finance): Proposed workflow: provisional hold for the full amount. Approve up to $18k USD equivalent now (Samir signoff). Hold remainder until reissued invoice and PO link. We need vendor bank details for cross-border payment too.
Samir (CFO): OK to approve provisional up to $18k USD equivalent given this is part of the experiment. Release once PO-2026-331 is created and vendor sends corrected invoice in USD. Any FX risk is on vendor per contract.
Nimbus Billing: We'll issue corrected invoice within 24 hours. We'll include both GBP and USD lines and indicate FX rate used. Also attaching CSV with line items: base subscription ￡11,500; overage GPUs ￡2,300; VAT ￡400.
Lena (Engops): Thanks. Can Engops confirm units? @Nimbus Billing, overage GPUs shows 46 units - can you include hours and region? We need telemetry match before final release.
Aisha - Procurement: Ticket created PRQ-2026-118. I'll update when PO reopened and linked.
Ravi (Finance): I'll flag accounting entry "provisional payment - pending PO 2026-331". Clara, once invoice arrives, can Treasury process USD wire?
Clara (Treasury): Yes, once we've received USD invoice and bank NN & SWIFT, we can wire. If vendor sends GBP we need explicit FX acceptance.
Nimbus Billing: Corrected invoice sent to Coupa with PO=PO-2026-331 and USD totals.
POBot: PO-2026-331 created and linked to legacy PO_LEG_0088. Status: OPEN.
Ravi (Finance): Great. Queuing provisional release per CFO approval. Holding $2,100 pending unit reconciliation and VAT verification.
Samir (CFO): Documenting exception: provisional release for experiment vendors. Finance to include memo and FP&A to sample-check telemetry against invoice.
Lena (Engops): I'll run the usage check and report back by EOD. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
